description: This file contains the implementation of the Bootstrap affix plugin (version 3.2.0), defining the Affix class, its methods, and plugin initialization code for affix behavior in web pages.

classes.name: Affix
classes.description: Class implementing the affix behavior, managing element positioning based on scroll position.

methods.name: getPinnedOffset
methods.description: Calculates and caches the offset position when the element is affixed.

methods.name: checkPositionWithEventLoop
methods.description: Schedules a position check after a short delay.

methods.name: checkPosition
methods.description: Determines whether the element should be affixed to top, bottom, or not at all based on scroll position.
